title: Edible Mud BTA
description: Adds edible mud to Better than Adventure!
body:
Adds edible mud. Only for BTA! babric.

Edible mud is consumed in one bite and heals only a single health point.

## Recipe
You can create edible mud by cooking baked mud, naturally.

![Baked mud being cooked into edible mud in a furnace.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ea651af7d57fb27171f2b55663a85f851015d085.png)
